repair.title: Handwashing Reached More Homes
repair.summary: UNICEF reported that access to basic hand hygiene at home rose from 5.0 billion people in 2015 to 5.5 billion in 2020.
repair.why_it_matters: Soap and water at home are simple infrastructure that can prevent infection and protect daily life.
repair.caveat: If trends continue, many people will still lack basic hand hygiene at the end of the decade.
